summary: Nexera Technologies Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting a registered direct offering of 1,200,000 ordinary shares and concurrent private placement of warrants to purchase up to 1,200,000 ordinary shares at $1.00 per unit, for aggregate gross proceeds of approximately $1.2 million. The offering was conducted under an effective shelf registration statement and is expected to close on June 9, 2026. Proceeds will be used for working capital and general corporate purposes. This is a routine capital-raising transaction, not a special situation; thus no deal terms are applicable. No board recommendation or advisor is named. The filing is an ordinary shelf takedown and does not represent a special situation.
